summary: BI-99C76A90 (Simplify & Strengthen B5 Seam D / W19, architecture pass 2026-08-16 §3.2-c). EXPAND phase of the vertical clone collapse: migration 20260818090000 creates the unified resource-scheduling family — Resource, ResourceAvailability, ResourceCapacityPool, ResourceCapacityAllocation (all EMPTY at birth, discriminated by the new ResourceDomain enum, born on the W20 RecordLifecycle convention, sourceRef provenance keys for idempotent backfill) — plus one nullable all-NULL RecurringSchedule.recurrenceScheduleId FK (NOT VALID) folding finance billing cadence onto the ONE canonical RecurrenceSchedule. NO row is read, written, or dropped; NO existing column changes; the clone families (Beauty*/Hospitality*/ProviderAvailability) remain authoritative. Dual-read adapters: apps/web/lib/resource-scheduling/ (pure, unit-tested, unmappable legacy values warn instead of coercing). Data backfill + dual-write + clone drop are OPERATOR-REVIEW-REQUIRED per docs/superpowers/plans/2026-08-18-w19-vertical-clone-collapse-data-migration-plan.md — nothing destructive ships in this PR. New CI ratchet: check-no-new-resource-clone-models.mjs (8-clone shrink-only baseline, owner platform-architecture, expiry 2026-11-16) blocks NEW *Availability/*CapacityAllocation/*CapacityPool/*RecurrenceSchedule/*RecurringSchedule-shaped models outside the unified family. No sensitive/subject fields: rows describe operating fixtures (chairs, tables, pools) and time windows; the only person-adjacent columns are opaque provenance refs (subjectRef/sourceRef) to rows already governed in their identity homes.
